b1-demokracia-01.title: Communicative Challenge: The Fundamental Law
b1-demokracia-01.scenario: You are preparing for the citizenship interview with a teacher, Mrs Kovács. She asks you about the basic law of Hungary.
b1-demokracia-01.prompt: Tell her which law is the basis of the state, and what the Constitutional Court watches over.
cues: Say what the court watches over
b1-demokracia-01.target: Az Alaptörvény az állam működésének alapja. Az Alkotmánybíróság őrködik a jogszabályok alkotmányossága felett.
b1-demokracia-01.english: The Fundamental Law is the basis of how the state works. The Constitutional Court watches over the constitutionality of legal rules.
b1-demokracia-01.canDo: I can explain what the Fundamental Law, the separation of powers and the Constitutional Court are.

b1-demokracia-02.title: Communicative Challenge: The National Assembly
b1-demokracia-02.scenario: You are practising for the citizenship interview with a teacher, Mrs Kovács. She asks how parliament and the Prime Minister work.
b1-demokracia-02.prompt: Say how many members parliament has and who elects the Prime Minister.
cues: Say who elects the Prime Minister
b1-demokracia-02.target: Az Országgyűlésnek 199 képviselője van. A miniszterelnököt az Országgyűlés választja meg.
b1-demokracia-02.english: The National Assembly has 199 members. The Prime Minister is elected by the National Assembly.
b1-demokracia-02.canDo: I can name the main state bodies: the National Assembly, the President and the Government.

b1-demokracia-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Joining NATO
b1-demokracia-03.scenario: On a visit to a museum exhibition about 1999, the guide asks you what you know about Hungary and NATO.
b1-demokracia-03.prompt: Tell the guide when Hungary joined NATO and what the fifth article says.
cues: Say what an attack on one member means
b1-demokracia-03.target: Magyarország 1999. március 12-én lett a NATO tagja. Egy tag megtámadása az egész szövetség elleni támadás.
b1-demokracia-03.english: Hungary became a member of NATO on 12 March 1999. An attack on one member is an attack on the whole alliance.
b1-demokracia-03.canDo: I can say when and how Hungary joined NATO.

b1-demokracia-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Joining the European Union
b1-demokracia-04.scenario: You are at a history class for the citizenship interview. The teacher asks about the European Union.
b1-demokracia-04.prompt: Say when Hungary joined the Union and what changed at the Austrian and Slovak borders in 2007.
cues: Say what changed at the borders
b1-demokracia-04.target: Magyarország 2004. május 1-jén csatlakozott az Európai Unióhoz. 2007-ben megszűnt a határellenőrzés Ausztria és Szlovákia felé.
b1-demokracia-04.english: Hungary joined the European Union on 1 May 2004. In 2007 border control towards Austria and Slovakia ended.
b1-demokracia-04.canDo: I can say when Hungary joined the European Union and what the four freedoms are.

b1-demokracia-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Hungarians Abroad
b1-demokracia-05.scenario: At a talk about the Day of National Cohesion, a woman from Kolozsvár asks what you have learned.
b1-demokracia-05.prompt: Say what the Fundamental Law says about Hungarians outside the borders, and which day is the Day of National Cohesion.
cues: Say what Hungary bears responsibility for
b1-demokracia-05.target: Az Alaptörvény szerint Magyarország felelősséget visel a határain kívül élő magyarok sorsáért. A Nemzeti Összetartozás Napja június 4-e.
b1-demokracia-05.english: According to the Fundamental Law, Hungary bears responsibility for the fate of Hungarians living outside its borders. The Day of National Cohesion is 4 June.
b1-demokracia-05.canDo: I can say what the Fundamental Law says about Hungarians living outside the borders.

b1-demokracia-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Modern Hungary in Short
b1-demokracia-consolidation.scenario: In the citizenship interview, the examiner asks you for a short summary of modern Hungary.
b1-demokracia-consolidation.prompt: Say what kind of state Hungary is, and when it joined NATO and the European Union.
cues: Say the form of the state
b1-demokracia-consolidation.target: Magyarország köztársaság és demokratikus jogállam. 1999-ben a NATO, 2004-ben az Európai Unió tagja lett.
b1-demokracia-consolidation.english: Hungary is a republic and a democratic state governed by the rule of law. It became a member of NATO in 1999 and of the European Union in 2004.
b1-demokracia-consolidation.canDo: I can talk about modern Hungary's institutions and its NATO and EU membership.

b1-nemzetijelkepek-01.title: Communicative Challenge: The Flag
b1-nemzetijelkepek-01.scenario: You are at a museum exhibition about national symbols. The guide, Mrs Kovács, asks you about the Hungarian flag.
b1-nemzetijelkepek-01.prompt: Tell her what the flag looks like and what the green stripe traditionally means.
cues: Say how many stripes and which colours
Say what green means by tradition
b1-nemzetijelkepek-01.target: A magyar zászló három vízszintes sávból áll: piros, fehér és zöld. A hagyomány szerint a zöld a reményt jelképezi.
b1-nemzetijelkepek-01.english: The Hungarian flag has three horizontal stripes: red, white and green. By tradition, green stands for hope.
b1-nemzetijelkepek-01.canDo: I can describe the Hungarian flag and say what its colours traditionally mean.

b1-nemzetijelkepek-02.title: Communicative Challenge: The Holy Crown
b1-nemzetijelkepek-02.scenario: You are visiting the Parliament building with your class for the citizenship course. The guide asks what you know about the Holy Crown.
b1-nemzetijelkepek-02.prompt: Say where the Holy Crown is now and when it came back to Hungary.
cues: Say the year it came home
b1-nemzetijelkepek-02.target: A Szent Korona 2000 óta az Országházban van. 1978-ban tért haza az Egyesült Államokból.
b1-nemzetijelkepek-02.english: The Holy Crown has been in the Parliament building since 2000. It came home from the United States in 1978.
b1-nemzetijelkepek-02.canDo: I can say where the Holy Crown is kept and what the Doctrine of the Holy Crown says.

b1-nemzetijelkepek-03.title: Communicative Challenge: The Coat of Arms
b1-nemzetijelkepek-03.scenario: In the citizenship interview, the examiner asks you about the coat of arms.
b1-nemzetijelkepek-03.prompt: Say what is in the first field of the coat of arms and what tradition says about the stripes.
cues: Say what the first field shows
Say what the silver stripes stand for by tradition
b1-nemzetijelkepek-03.target: Az első mezőben az Árpád-sávok vannak. A néphagyomány szerint a négy ezüst sáv négy folyót jelképez.
b1-nemzetijelkepek-03.english: The first field has the Árpád stripes. According to folk tradition, the four silver stripes symbolise four rivers.
b1-nemzetijelkepek-03.canDo: I can describe the Hungarian coat of arms and its two fields.

b1-nemzetijelkepek-04.title: Communicative Challenge: The Himnusz
b1-nemzetijelkepek-04.scenario: A teacher, Mr Nagy, asks you about the Himnusz before a school ceremony on 22 January.
b1-nemzetijelkepek-04.prompt: Tell him who wrote the Himnusz, who composed the music, and what people do while it is sung.
b1-nemzetijelkepek-04.target: Kölcsey Ferenc írta a Himnusz szövegét, Erkel Ferenc pedig a zenéjét szerezte. Szokás, hogy az emberek felállnak.
b1-nemzetijelkepek-04.english: Ferenc Kölcsey wrote the text of the Himnusz and Ferenc Erkel composed its music. It is the custom for people to stand up.
b1-nemzetijelkepek-04.canDo: I can say who wrote the Himnusz and who composed its music, and when.

b1-nemzetijelkepek-05.title: Communicative Challenge: The Szózat
b1-nemzetijelkepek-05.scenario: At a small ceremony, a woman from the choir asks if you know the Szózat.
b1-nemzetijelkepek-05.prompt: Say who wrote it and how it begins.
b1-nemzetijelkepek-05.target: Vörösmarty Mihály írta a Szózatot. Így kezdődik: Hazádnak rendületlenül légy híve, óh magyar.
b1-nemzetijelkepek-05.english: Mihály Vörösmarty wrote the Szózat. It begins: Hazádnak rendületlenül légy híve, óh magyar.
b1-nemzetijelkepek-05.canDo: I can say who wrote and who composed the Szózat, and recognise its first line.

b1-nemzetijelkepek-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: National Symbols in Short
b1-nemzetijelkepek-consolidation.scenario: In the citizenship interview, the examiner asks you which symbols the Fundamental Law names and who wrote the two poems.
b1-nemzetijelkepek-consolidation.prompt: Name the three state symbols and say who wrote the Himnusz and the Szózat.
b1-nemzetijelkepek-consolidation.target: A címer, a zászló és a Himnusz állami jelképek. A Himnuszt Kölcsey Ferenc írta, a Szózatot Vörösmarty Mihály.
b1-nemzetijelkepek-consolidation.english: The coat of arms, the flag and the Himnusz are state symbols. Ferenc Kölcsey wrote the Himnusz and Mihály Vörösmarty the Szózat.
b1-nemzetijelkepek-consolidation.canDo: I can talk about Hungary's national symbols and their authors.

b1-nemzetiunnepek-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Pest, 15 March 1848
b1-nemzetiunnepek-01.scenario: At the citizenship interview the examiner asks what the young people did in Pest on 15 March 1848.
b1-nemzetiunnepek-01.prompt: Tell the examiner where the young people met and what they printed.
b1-nemzetiunnepek-01.target: A fiatalok a Pilvax kávéházban gyűltek össze. Kinyomtatták a tizenkét pontot.
b1-nemzetiunnepek-01.english: The young people met in the Pilvax Café. They printed the Twelve Points.
b1-nemzetiunnepek-01.canDo: I can say what March 15 commemorates and what happened in Pest in 1848.

b1-nemzetiunnepek-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Saint Stephen's Day
b1-nemzetiunnepek-02.scenario: On a school visit in Budapest the teacher asks you, a visitor preparing for citizenship, what people celebrate on 20 August.
b1-nemzetiunnepek-02.prompt: Tell the teacher what the holiday is for and what people watch in the evening.
cues: Say what people watch in the evening
b1-nemzetiunnepek-02.target: Augusztus 20-án az államalapítást ünnepeljük. Este tűzijátékot néznek a Duna felett.
b1-nemzetiunnepek-02.english: On August 20 we celebrate the founding of the state. In the evening they watch fireworks over the Danube.
b1-nemzetiunnepek-02.canDo: I can say what August 20 commemorates and how people celebrate it.

b1-nemzetiunnepek-03.title: Communicative Challenge: The Republic of 1989
b1-nemzetiunnepek-03.scenario: At the citizenship interview the examiner asks what happened on 23 October 1989.
b1-nemzetiunnepek-03.prompt: Tell the examiner who proclaimed the Republic and from where.
cues: Say from where he did it
b1-nemzetiunnepek-03.target: Szűrös Mátyás kikiáltotta a Magyar Köztársaságot a Parlament erkélyéről.
b1-nemzetiunnepek-03.english: Mátyás Szűrös proclaimed the Republic of Hungary from the balcony of the Parliament.
b1-nemzetiunnepek-03.canDo: I can say what happened on 23 October 1956 and on 23 October 1989.

b1-nemzetiunnepek-04.title: Communicative Challenge: The Martyrs of Arad
b1-nemzetiunnepek-04.scenario: In a museum in Budapest the guide asks you what the nation remembers on 6 October.
b1-nemzetiunnepek-04.prompt: Tell the guide whom the nation remembers on October 6 and in which year they were executed.
cues: Say in which year they were executed
b1-nemzetiunnepek-04.target: Október 6-án az aradi vértanúkra emlékezünk. Őket 1849-ben végezték ki.
b1-nemzetiunnepek-04.english: On October 6 we remember the martyrs of Arad. They were executed in 1849.
b1-nemzetiunnepek-04.canDo: I can say whom the nation remembers on October 6 and what June 4 is the day of.

b1-nemzetiunnepek-05.title: Communicative Challenge: A Day of Remembrance
b1-nemzetiunnepek-05.scenario: At the House of Terror Museum a teacher asks you what is remembered on 16 April.
b1-nemzetiunnepek-05.prompt: Tell the teacher what April 16 is the memorial day of and what began on that day in 1944.
cues: Say what the memorial day is for
b1-nemzetiunnepek-05.target: Április 16-a a holokauszt magyarországi áldozatainak emléknapja. 1944-ben ezen a napon kezdődött a gettósítás.
b1-nemzetiunnepek-05.english: April 16 is the memorial day of the Hungarian victims of the Holocaust. In 1944 the ghettoisation began on this day.
b1-nemzetiunnepek-05.canDo: I can say what February 25 and April 16 commemorate.

b1-nemzetiunnepek-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: The Three National Holidays
b1-nemzetiunnepek-consolidation.scenario: At the citizenship interview the examiner asks you to name the national holidays of Hungary.
b1-nemzetiunnepek-consolidation.target: A három nemzeti ünnep március 15., augusztus 20. és október 23.
b1-nemzetiunnepek-consolidation.english: The three national holidays are March 15, August 20 and October 23.
b1-nemzetiunnepek-consolidation.canDo: I can name the three national holidays and say what each commemorates.

b1-alaptorveny-01.title: Communicative Challenge: When Did It Come Into Force?
b1-alaptorveny-01.scenario: At the citizenship interview the examiner asks when the Fundamental Law was adopted and when it came into force.
b1-alaptorveny-01.prompt: Tell the examiner when Parliament adopted the Fundamental Law and when it came into force.
cues: Say when it came into force
b1-alaptorveny-01.target: Az Országgyűlés 2011. április 18-án fogadta el az Alaptörvényt. 2012. január 1-jén lépett hatályba.
b1-alaptorveny-01.english: Parliament adopted the Fundamental Law on 18 April 2011. It came into force on 1 January 2012.
b1-alaptorveny-01.canDo: I can say when the Fundamental Law was adopted and when it came into force.

b1-alaptorveny-02.title: Communicative Challenge: How It Begins
b1-alaptorveny-02.scenario: On a visit to the Parliament building a guide asks you, a visitor preparing for citizenship, how the Fundamental Law begins.
b1-alaptorveny-02.prompt: Tell the guide what the first line of the Fundamental Law is and which text follows it.
cues: Say what the opening text is called
b1-alaptorveny-02.target: Az Alaptörvény első sora: Isten, áldd meg a magyart! Utána következik a Nemzeti hitvallás.
b1-alaptorveny-02.english: The first line of the Fundamental Law is: God, bless the Hungarians! The National Avowal follows.
b1-alaptorveny-02.canDo: I can say what the National Avowal is and how it begins.

b1-alaptorveny-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Dignity and Life
b1-alaptorveny-03.scenario: At the citizenship interview the examiner asks what the Fundamental Law says about human dignity.
b1-alaptorveny-03.prompt: Tell the examiner what the Fundamental Law says about dignity and about life.
cues: Say what the law says about dignity
Say what everyone has the right to
b1-alaptorveny-03.target: Az emberi méltóság sérthetetlen. Mindenkinek joga van az élethez.
b1-alaptorveny-03.english: Human dignity is inviolable. Everyone has the right to life.
b1-alaptorveny-03.canDo: I can name some rights in the Freedom and Responsibility chapter, such as dignity and equality before the law.

b1-alaptorveny-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Power and Duty
b1-alaptorveny-04.scenario: A teacher asks you, a learner preparing for the citizenship interview, how the state is organised.
b1-alaptorveny-04.prompt: Tell the teacher which institution holds the legislative power and name one civic duty.
cues: Say which institution holds the legislative power
b1-alaptorveny-04.target: A törvényhozó hatalom az Országgyűlés. A haza védelme minden magyar állampolgár kötelessége.
b1-alaptorveny-04.english: The legislative power is the National Assembly. Defending the homeland is the duty of every Hungarian citizen.
b1-alaptorveny-04.canDo: I can name the three branches of power and the institutions that exercise them.

b1-alaptorveny-05.title: Communicative Challenge: The Guardian of the Law
b1-alaptorveny-05.scenario: At the citizenship interview the examiner asks what the Constitutional Court does.
b1-alaptorveny-05.prompt: Tell the examiner what the Court protects and what it does with an unconstitutional regulation.
cues: Say what it does with an unconstitutional regulation
b1-alaptorveny-05.target: Az Alkotmánybíróság védi az Alaptörvényt. Megsemmisíti az alaptörvény-ellenes jogszabályt.
b1-alaptorveny-05.english: The Constitutional Court protects the Fundamental Law. It annuls the unconstitutional regulation.
b1-alaptorveny-05.canDo: I can say what the Constitutional Court and the Commissioner for Fundamental Rights do.

b1-alaptorveny-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: The Shape of the Fundamental Law
b1-alaptorveny-consolidation.scenario: At the citizenship interview the examiner asks how the Fundamental Law is built up.
b1-alaptorveny-consolidation.prompt: Tell the examiner which text introduces the Fundamental Law and which chapter comes second.
cues: Say which text opens the law
b1-alaptorveny-consolidation.target: Az Alaptörvény bevezetője a Nemzeti hitvallás. A második fejezet a Szabadság és felelősség.
b1-alaptorveny-consolidation.english: The introduction of the Fundamental Law is the National Avowal. The second chapter is Freedom and Responsibility.
b1-alaptorveny-consolidation.canDo: I can say what the Fundamental Law begins with and name its chapters.
